snippet.title: The Main Menu Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Main Menu is a psychological horror puzzle point & click game where the main menu itself is alive.

You wake up trapped in a room, but the only thing you can interact with is the game’s corrupted main menu. All of the ui and hidden systems become part of the puzzle. Changing the menu can physically affect the room around you.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897660/The_Main_Menu/?utm_source=youtube
